rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when the unspecified time may be in the past or future.

example.jyutping: ngo5 mau5 go3 si4 hau6 wui5 zoi3 wan2 nei5

rows.note: Use this for an unspecified time later in the future, especially when it means “later.”

example.jyutping: ci4 di1 ngo5 dei6 zoi3 king1

rows.note: Use this for one indefinite occasion in the past, not for a future occasion.

example.english: I ran into him in Mong Kok sometime last year.
example.traditional: 有次我上年喺旺角撞到佢。
example.jyutping: jau5 ci3 ngo5 soeng6 nin4 hai2 wong6 gok3 zong6 dou2 keoi5
